title: Will the #1 Show on Netflix have at least 12 million views?
rules: If the #1 Show on Netflix has at least 12 million views on the chart published on Nov 3, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
rules_secondary:
This market specifically encompasses the number of “Views” (not hours viewed) of
the top Show ranked on Netflix’s weekly charts for Global "Shows  | English"  chart.

The Netflix charts are updated on Tuesday. Therefore, the market will close at 11:59 PM ET the day before. The chart published on Nov 3, 2026 will be for the week ending the previous Sunday.

This market and these products have not been endorsed by Netflix. Any references to Netflix, or any associated marks are descriptive only and do not indicate an endorsement of this product or any affiliation between Netflix and Kalshi.

blind.reasoning: The current English TV leaders are weak: Below fell to 7.7M in its third week and Nobody Wants This S3 opened with 6.2M. The likely #1 for Oct 26–Nov 1 is the new docuseries 'The One About Matthew Perry', which was #2 on FlixPatrol's daily chart on Oct 29 behind the non-English Lupin. A celebrity docuseries in a partial debut week can reach 12M, but that is above the typical outcome, so YES is less likely than not.
blind.falsifier: Netflix's Nov 3 chart shows 'The One About Matthew Perry' (or another new English series) at #1 with 12M+ views.

final.reasoning: The thin orderbook pulled my estimate down slightly, from 0.32 to 0.27. That sits above the 0.195 midpoint but at or below the 0.28 ask, so buying YES has little edge given my uncertainty about the Matthew Perry docuseries' release timing and format.
